title: A framework for producing harmonic maps
summary: We present a general framework for producing families of harmonic maps from the unit ball into the Euclidean sphere starting from a fixed harmonic map. In particular, our analysis provides a theoretical background for a generalized radial projection which was recently introduced by Nakauchi. Our approach is based on work of Toth who established a machinery that generates eigenmaps between spheres from a given eigenmap.
